samples.summary: `format()`'s new throw fires *after* the mutation in every un-migrated command, turning a successful write into exit 1 / INVALID_FORMAT
samples.evidence: Only `status`, `ctx list` and `schema` call `parseOutputFormat` up front. Every other `output()` call site still passes the raw `opts.format` *after* the request has been sent: `cells.ts:66` (`sheets cells set`), `cells.ts:92` (delete), `cells.ts:139` (batch), `docs.ts:104/136/154` (create/rename/delete), `notes.ts:64+`, `slides.ts:69+`, `sheets-import.ts:91`, `api-keys.ts:20/34/48`, `tabs.ts:16`. With the new `default:` branch in `format()` (formatter.ts:51-55), `wafflebase sheets cells set … --format bogus` now performs the PATCH, then throws inside the try block, and `outputError` sets `process.exitCode = 1` with an INVALID_FORMAT body — so a caller/agent sees a failure for an operation that actually succeeded and may retry it (duplicate writes). Previously the same invocation printed "undefined" and exited 0. `api-keys create --format bogus` is worst: the key is created and its one-time secret is discarded, now reported as an error. Fix belongs in those call sites (validate before issuing the request), not in the diff's files.

samples.summary: `--quiet` bypasses the new format validation for every command that has not been migrated
samples.evidence: `output()` returns before calling `format()` when `quiet` is true (formatter.ts:59-62), so `wafflebase docs get X --format bogus --quiet` (docs.ts:118) silently exits 0 and never validates, while `status --format bogus --quiet` exits 1 because `parseOutputFormat` runs ahead of `output()` (status.ts:64). The new INVALID_FORMAT contract is therefore honoured inconsistently depending on `--quiet` and on which command you invoke.

samples.summary: Documented global `--format` vocabulary includes `yaml`, which the new validator now rejects
samples.evidence: docs/design/cli.md:373 documents the global flag as `--format json|table|csv|yaml (default: json)`, and the in-code comments at notes.ts:181 and slides.ts:189 repeat "the global `OutputFormat` union (json|table|csv|yaml)". `OUTPUT_FORMATS` (formatter.ts:7) has no `yaml`, so `status --format yaml` now fails with `Invalid --format "yaml". Use one of: json, table, csv.` — the docs and comments describe a vocabulary the new guard refuses. Either the doc/comments or the format list needs updating.

samples.summary: Agent hunter comment justifying its CLI bypass is now factually stale
samples.evidence: scripts/agent/hunt-workspace.mjs:15-20 states "`status` ignores `--format json` and prints prose … That is ground-truth defect #9" and uses that as the rationale for resolving the workspace from config/session files instead of the CLI. After this change `status` does emit JSON, so the recorded justification (and the referenced ground-truth defect) no longer holds; the file was not updated alongside the fix.

samples.summary: `formatTable` behaviour change silently alters `--format table` output for every single-object command outside the diff
samples.evidence: Before, `formatTable` returned '(no results)' for any non-array input; now a plain object renders as a key/value table. That changes existing output for out-of-diff consumers such as `docs get` (docs.ts:118), `cells get` (cells.ts:26), `api-keys create` (api-keys.ts:20 — which prints the one-time raw key) and `sheets import` (sheets-import.ts:91) under `--format table`. Almost certainly an improvement, but no other consumer or doc of the old '(no results)' contract was reviewed/updated.

verdict.reason: The finding is accurate as described. formatter.ts:51-55 adds a throwing `default:` branch to `format()`, and formatter.ts:78-88 (`outputError`) sets `process.exitCode = 1` with the `INVALID_FORMAT` code. No upstream validation exists: root.ts:53 registers `--format <fmt>` with no `.choices()`, `getGlobalOpts` (root.ts:24-27) only casts, and bin.ts:1-27 installs no preAction hook. Only status.ts:64, schema.ts:21 and ctx.ts:73 call `parseOutputFormat`. Every other call site passes raw `opts.format` to `output()` after the mutating request has completed and inside the same try/catch: cells.ts:66 (PUT setCell), cells.ts:92 (DELETE deleteCell), cells.ts:139 (PATCH batchCells), docs.ts:104 (create), docs.ts:136 (rename), docs.ts:154 (delete), api-keys.ts:20 (createApiKey, with quiet hardcoded to false so format() always runs and the one-time secret is lost), plus tabs.ts:16, sheets-import.ts:91, notes.ts:64/78/96/114, slides.ts:69/83/101/119. So `--format bogus` now performs the write and then reports exit 1 / INVALID_FORMAT, inviting retries and duplicate writes. This is a behaviour change to an exported symbol whose other consumers were not updated — squarely the blast-radius lane, major impact.
